'''Sneevels''' were a [[Hair|fur]]-covered [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]. [[Boles Roor]] was a Sneevel [[Podracer]] [[pilot]] from the world of [[Sneeve]] who competed in at least three [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|Podraces]], two of which the pilot had won. A more infamous Sneevel was the [[Garel City]] [[crime lord]] [[Skraik]], who operated in the [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War]].

==Biology and appearance==
Sneevels were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]<ref name="EYNTK" /> that possessed [[Hair|fur]] covered bodies and partially fur covered heads. One Sneevel possessed fur that was beige and gray in [[color]], and also had lightly colored skin in addition to yellow [[eye]]s. Sneevel's had pointy ears, and could be identified by their toothy underbites, spade-shaped noses, and hunched posture. Sneevel's also had long, skinny arms.<ref name="TPM" />

==Society and culture==
At least one Sneevel, [[Boles Roor]] pursued the sport of [[podracing]].<ref name="TPM" /> During the [[Imperial Era|Age of the Empire]], [[Skraik]] was a Sneevel [[crime lord]] who operated on the [[planet]] [[Garel]].<ref name="TSOTF">{{RebelsMagCite|29|The Size of the Fight}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|It's two-time winner, Boles Roor!|Fode, a [[Troig]] commentator, introduces Roor to the Boonta spectators|<ref name="TPM" />}}
[[File:Boles_Roor_Screen.png|thumb|left|200px|Boles Roor's face on a Boonta race holoscreen]]
The Sneevel Boles Roor [[Homeworld|hailed]] from [[Sneeve]],<ref name="EYNTK" /> and the species had integrated into the large [[The galaxy|galaxy]] during the final [[Standard decade|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. As a [[Podracer]] [[pilot]], Roor competed in at least three [[Boonta Eve Classic]] races on the planet [[Tatooine]], two of which they had won. During a later Boonta race, which coincided with the [[Invasion of Naboo]], the race announcer [[Fodesinbeed Annodue|Fode Annodue]] mentioned Roor's victories as they introduced Roor to race's audience. Despite previous victories, Roor did not win the race,<ref name="TPM" /> and instead placed sixth. Roor later took their beige-colored Podracer and raced on a [[Water|snow]]-covered world ten [[Standard year|years]] later.<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

Much later during the [[Imperial Era|Age of the Empire]], a Sneevel crime lord named Skraik operated a [[Skraik's gang|gang]] out the planet Garel in [[Garel City]]. In attempt to force his cohorts to work for free, Skraik terrorized them with a pet [[gundark]] named [[Gigi (Gundark)|Gigi]]. Despite his initial success with this tactic, his henchmen eventually turned against him with the help of the [[Lasat]] [[Garazeb Orrelios]]. The gang members overwhelmed Gigi, whom Skraik was using as a mount, and the gundark summarily turned against Skraik when the crime boss fell from her back. Skraik promptly fled the scene when Gigi took control of Skraik's [[electrostaff]].<ref name="TSOTF" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:VisualDictRoor.jpg|thumb|right|225px|The art department's sculpture of Roor was based on conceptual art by [[Terryl Whitlatch]].]]
Sneevels were created for the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. Although detailed conceptual art and full body maquettes for the species,<ref name="DB-Roor">{{DB|character|bolesroor|Roor, Boles}}</ref> at the time referred to only as "Shaggy Podracer,"<ref name="Insider's Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> the film's resident Sneevel, Boles Roor, only appeared as a low res digital model used for distance shots of the character's Podracer. The maquette of Roor was then used for a holoscreen display that appeared in the commentator box.<ref name="DB-Roor" /> Roor and their Podracer later appeared again in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] on a [[holoprojector]].<ref name="AotC" /><ref name="DB-Roor-Racer">{{DB|vehicle|bolesroorspodracer|Podracer, Boles Roor's}}</ref>

Although the film does not identify the species by name, the [[canon]] source book ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' confirmed the name.<ref name="EYNTK" />
